استقيموا (form X)
# اُسْتُقِيمُوا (ustuqīmū) /us.tu.qiː.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقَامَ (istaqāma)
# اِسْتَقِيمُوا (istaqīmū) /is.ta.qiː.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقَامَ (istaqāma)
